top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Fall, Bonds in Focus After Rally: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks declined as oil surged on the prospect of renewed US-Iran conflict, reviving inflation concerns. Bonds will be in focus after Treasuries rebounded in the New York session.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Oil prices rose sharply Thursday following a report the U.S. is sending a third aircraft carrier strike group to the Middle East.

top_signals.title: Illinois will postpone implementation of crypto tax following lawsuit
top_signals.summary: State officials agreed to delay the 0.2% crypto tax for six months after lawsuits and industry pushback claimed the bill was rushed through the legislature.
